sequenceReference.note: This is the future, separately scoped one-golden-slice-shaped package that planning/gj01-v12-src-adapters-delivery-boundary-authority.json anticipated targeting src/adapters, scoped narrowly to a persistence port/adapter only — not the full one-golden-slice/walking-skeleton and not delivery.

goal: Give CreateCustomerPipeline's ALLOW_COMMIT preparedChangeSet a real, application-owned JS persistence port that commits against the PostgreSQL S1 substrate inside one attested tenant transaction, using a real Docker-backed PostgreSQL 16 instance in tests, never a mock.
allowedFilesNote: The last two test files were added mid-package by explicit MASTER decision (option a) after RED surfaced two locked, unrelated invariants — 'package.json carries no dependency key' and 'this package does not materialize src/adapters' — that directly conflicted with the authorized pg driver and the boundary this package walks through.

scopeResolution.note: The S1 substrate (db/metaframer_kernel_db) owns exactly two runtime tables — transactional_outbox and audit_log — and no customer-owning table. Materializing a customer table is a separate, out-of-scope decision (forbidden by this package's non-goals, and by the substrate's own contract, which names no domain record table). The adapter therefore commits three of the pipeline's four ALLOW_COMMIT write intents for real inside one attested tenant transaction, and defers the fourth honestly rather than inventing a table to close it.

committedMechanism.idempotency: realized as that outbox row's dedup_key, enforced by the substrate's own per-tenant unique index — a repeated commit with the same fingerprint is refused by the database itself, proven in tests/postgres-commit-adapter.test.mjs

scopeResolution.deferredReason: no customer-owning runtime table exists in the S1 substrate; materializing one is a separate, out-of-scope decision for a future package
scopeResolution.commitReceiptNote: The adapter mints no CommitReceipt claiming the customer intent was persisted. It returns a narrower, honest commit contract naming exactly which intents committed and which stayed deferred. A future package may close the customer gap once a customer-owning table (or an explicit decision not to have one) is separately authorized.

nonGoals: no src/delivery directory or file is created
no HTTP, ASGI, Uvicorn, Hypercorn, FastAPI or Django delivery surface
no change to db/metaframer_kernel_db or its Alembic revisions
no change to src/application or src/domain behaviour
no CommitReceipt minted for the customer intent
no mock or in-memory substrate used to satisfy GREEN
no app, module or release/deploy/publish path
no version bump, no README change
no readiness, MVP, buildable, releasable, deployable or production claim anywhere in this package

red.note: Before src/adapters/postgres-commit-adapter.mjs existed, every test importing it failed with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND — a real capability gap, not an environment failure.

requirements: npm run check must be GREEN

rollback.trigger: the adapter's committed/deferred intent split, or the src/adapters ring materialization it proves, drifts from this record
rollback.action: revert src/adapters/postgres-commit-adapter.mjs, tests/postgres-commit-adapter.test.mjs, the repository-boundary/substrate test updates, package.json's pg dependency and package-lock.json, and this planning file and the CHANGELOG.md entry as one shard
rollback.blastRadius: adapter-and-tests-only; no db/ or delivery surface touched
rollback.runtimeDataImpact: none: the adapter writes only to the disposable Docker container the test itself creates and removes

userJourney.before: CreateCustomerPipeline üretebiliyordu ama ürettiği ALLOW_COMMIT taslağını hiçbir yer PostgreSQL'e yazamıyordu; audit ve outbox niyetleri kağıt üzerinde kalıyordu.
userJourney.after: Artık gerçek bir PostgreSQL 16 bağlantısı üzerinden, tek bir kiracı işleminde audit ve outbox kaydı gerçekten yazılabiliyor ve aynı fingerprint ile ikinci kez gönderilen bir istek veritabanının kendisi tarafından reddediliyor. Müşteri (customer) kaydı için henüz bir tablo yok, o yüzden bu paket müşteriyi kalıcı hale getirmiyor — sadece denetim izini ve outbox mesajını.
userJourney.note: Hâlâ hiçbir HTTP sunucu veya form gönderimi çalışmıyor; bu B1 sadece uygulama katmanının veritabanına yazabildiğini kanıtlıyor.

nextPackage.note: B2 (customer persistence + full CommitReceipt) requires a separately authorized decision on whether/how a customer-owning table is materialized in the S1 substrate, and is out of this package's scope.
preconditions: this package's targeted GREEN, npm test and npm run check all pass
a separate Codex MASTER-approved package scopes the customer-owning table or an alternative persistence decision
